facts.text: Master Richie, with great respect, the cook has made forty pancakes, and you still wish for a friend.
facts.why: Cadbury doesn't say this. It is printed in quote marks. A real Richie line about food is 'Personally, I'd settle for soda and hot dogs at Wrigley Field.'
